summary: '[Errno -2] Name or service not known' means the host can't be reached; check provider host or the inventory.
questions: What does Name or service not known mean for a network device?

answer_card.title: Fix 'Name or service not known'
answer_card.answer_md: The host can't be resolved or reached. If you use `provider:`, check its `host:`. Otherwise check the inventory entry (hostname or `ansible_host`).
